svg.title: Idle balances compound under interest and converge under demurrage
svg.desc: Two parties with the same constant net inflow k but different starting balances. Left: under a positive return r their balances grow without bound and diverge exponentially. Right: under a demurrage rate delta both converge to the same steady state k over delta, the difference in starting wealth decaying with half-life ln 2 over delta.
svg.text: gap grows at rate r; no bound
